name: typecheck
run: node -e "const f=require('fs'),c=require('child_process');let r=0;const run=(cmd)=>{try{c.execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){r=1}};if(f.existsSync('package.json'))run('npm run typecheck --if-present');if(f.existsSync('pyproject.toml'))run('uv run mypy ingest --strict');process.exit(r)"
